content.title: Silver Hits Fresh Records
content.summary: Futures prices for the precious metal surged more than 6% Monday to top $50 a troy ounce.  Silver settled at $50.13, the highest level on record in New York—surpassing a longstanding record close of $48.70 an ounce, which was set when the Hunt brothers cornered the silver market in 1980.  In London, where a shortage of tradable metal has spooked traders, silver punched through $50 an ounce for the first time on Friday in a daily auction.
